line.comment: * Spawn additional Xenon defenders for 1 eligible Xenon sector.
* Normal garrisons require at least 1 Xenon Station in the sector.
* The Maelstrom garrison requires only the OCV portal.
* Core of the Xenon Empire around the OCV portal tends to get reinforced first and stronger.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Reworked.
* - Defender tracking now stores fleet leader instead of a boolean.
* - Reduced stronghold capital concentration: 2 M2 -> 1 M2, 2 M7 -> 1 M7
* - Number of garrisons is now dependent on game difficulty.
* - Removed random downgrade chance.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Returns an array of $xenons if successful, null otherwise.
* Return if no Xenon sectors remain.
* Build the garrison sector array.
* Portal sector is handled separately.
* Closest sector must be in the last index because for-each iterates tail to head.
* Total number of extra Defender fleets is based on X% of the greater of the Xenon's current sector count or garrison reference.
* Baseline: 60%.
* Only one garrison may exist per eligible sector. The Maelstrom portal counts as one additional eligible location.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Percentage now scales by difficulty. Easy: 0.75x, normal: 1x, hard: 1.33x, insane (non-OCV): 1.75x, insane (OCV alignment): 1.0x.
* Easy: 0.75x base percentage (45% of territory)
* Normal: 1.0x base percentage (60% of territory)
* Hard: 1.25x base percentage (75% of territory)
* Insane: If allied with OCV, the percentage is 1.0x (60% of territory). Otherwise, 1.66x (100% of territory).
* Maximum garrisons is scaled by the garrison reference or current Xenon territory, whichever is greater.
* Normal station-bearing sectors. The mandatory portal garrison is separate.
* Count active garrisons.
* Portal garrison is tracked separately and does not consume the normal garrison cap.
* Count normal active garrisons.
* Check all Xenon Stations in this sector.
* Add-Ons 2.2: The portal is prioritized. It must always have one Xenon garrison because OCV ships can leave on invasions.
* Portal always takes priority.
* Portal already defended. Check the normal garrison cap.
* Select the next eligible normal Xenon sector.
* Check all Xenon Stations in this sector.
* Only 1 extra garrison per sector.
* Ignore invalid/null distance values. The portal itself was already excluded above.
* Adjacent to Maelstrom; needs strongest defense.
* Core of the Xenon Empire up to 4 jumps around the portal. Medium Defense.
* Periphery sectors. Lowest extra defense.
* Find any Xenon Station in this sector to use as the spawn position.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Reworked Xenon garrison compositions and reduced capital concentration.
* Random C/Q M7 used by non-portal Xenon garrisons.
* Insane difficulty upgrades the M7 from a Xenon ship to an OCV ship.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Insane difficulty upgrades the ship type. M1 and M2 are not upgraded.
* Exception: Insane difficulty + OCV alignment reverts fleet composition back to standard.
* Standard periphery: 1 M7, 3 M6, 3 M3+, 6 M3
* Insane: upgrades all Ls to LX.
* Core: +33% more M3 and M6 over periphery.
* Standard core: 1 M1, 1 M7, 4 M6, 4 M3+, 8 M3
* Insane: upgrades all Ls to LX.
* Stronghold: +25% more M3 and M6 and +1 M7 over core
* Standard stronghold: 1 M2, 1 M1, 2 M7, 5 M6, 7 M3+, 8 M3 (2 M3s upgraded to M3+)
* Insane upgrades all Ls to LX. Upgrades 40% of M6 to PX.
* Fortress:
* - All M7s upgraded to G.
* - 50% of P upgraded to PX.
* - All Ls upgraded to LX.
* - +1 M6 and +33% more M3s over stronghold.
* Standard fortress: 1 M2, 1 M1, 2 M7, 6 M6, 20 M3+.
* Insane adds 1 additional M7 and upgrades 100% of P to PX.
* The G is preferred due to synergy with the M1 and M2. The OCV R is a sniper M7 that stays too far back.
* Maelstrom sector spawns elite forces to better protect the portal.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Changed from #deca.cefa to LX, since OCV virus can convert Xenon OCV ships (intended) and fighters represent carrier firepower.
* Hard and Insane upgrade the support type from L to LX.
* Store leader object. If leader dies, this location can spawn a new fleet later.
* Maelstrom garrisons are tracked by the portal; normal garrisons are tracked by the station.
* Assign the leader metadata to the portal or to ALL Xenon Stations in the sector if not in the portal sector.
